title: E2 — Content Store size sensitivity (W-syn)
description: Sweep of the byte budget of each Content Store (LRU) at the base workload; the median result is 6 KiB. W-syn: every agent makes callsPerAgent calls to fetch_page with an exponential think time between them; a fraction `overlap` of the calls is drawn from a shared catalog by Zipf(alpha), the rest ask for documents no other call asks for. Same seeds at every point; reductions are paired by seed against B0 (and B1).
